description: This file defines the IDBContext class and related utilities for managing IndexedDB transactions, including transaction reuse, lifecycle management, and object store interactions within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: IDBContext
classes.description: Manages IndexedDB transactions, reusing transactions to minimize overhead, and provides methods to run functions within transaction contexts.

classes.name: ObjectStore
classes.description: Wrapper around IDBObjectStore for simplified IndexedDB operations.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Wrapper around IDBIndex for index operations within object stores.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection after ensuring all transactions are complete.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a function within a managed transaction, ensuring sequential execution.

methods.name: #run
methods.description: Internal method to handle transaction lifecycle, retries, and mode management.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Waits for all pending transactions to complete.
